descriptionChirho: Abishai (אֲבִישַׁי, 'my father is a gift' or 'father of Jesse'), the son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab and Asahel, one of David's mighty warriors. All three clusters represent the same proper noun with minor grammatical variation: S79652 (10x) and S79653 (7x) are both bare nominative proper noun forms differing only in transliteration style (Abishai vs Avishai), while S79654 (8x) has the conjunctive waw prefix ('and Abishai'). Multilingual evidence is entirely uniform: English 'Abishai/Avishai', Spanish 'Abisai/Avishai', Hindi अबीशै/अब्शई, Arabic أَبْشَايَ/أَبيشايَ/أَبِيشَايُ, Korean 아비새/아비샤이, Swahili Abishai. The variation between S79652 and S79653 is purely orthographic/transliterational, not semantic. All 25 occurrences refer to the same individual across 1-2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.
